get_predict_unit: get a pretrained MLIP prediction unit by model name with default or turbo inference settings
pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name: download and return the local checkpoint file path for a named pretrained model from HuggingFace
get_reference_energies: retrieve atomic or form elemental reference energies for a pretrained model from HuggingFace
list_available_models: list all available pretrained model names from the fairchem calculate module
HuggingFaceCheckpoint: review the HuggingFaceCheckpoint dataclass that stores model filename, repo id, subfolder, and reference energy metadata
